q9af.name: q9af
q9af.hf_id: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B with its 8 full-attention layers distilled to GDN at m1
q9af.notes: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B config.json (verified in PR #14 review): 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 12288, GDN 16 key x 128 / 32 value x 128 heads; 6.92e9 non-embedding, 7.94e9 with input embeddings (LM head dropped). Params of the 8 converted layers change by <1% (GDN vs attention projections).

Attention projection shapes (gated q) unverified; only LoRA size depends on them.

rwkv7-13.3b.name: rwkv7-13.3b
rwkv7-13.3b.notes: 13.27e9 total (card); non-embedding/resident split assumes vocab 65536 x 4096 embeddings and an untied head. Module names are the HF custom modeling_rwkv7.py ones (att.receptance/key/value/output, ffn.key/value); fla-converted repos use attn.*_proj and need their own spec. Bundled WKV7 training throughput unverified -> low MFU.

mamba3-1.5b.name: mamba3-1.5b
mamba3-1.5b.notes: config: n_layer 24, d_intermediate 4096 (GatedMLP fc1/fc2 per block), ctx 2048, state 128. d_model 2048 inferred from 1.5e9 params; embeddings ~0.26e9 (llama-3.1 vocab).
